verdict.rationale: Agent-readable documentation is a fair question for a SaaS dev platform with a public docs site, so the axis applies. A direct probe of docs.lightsprint.ai/llms.txt returned HTTP 404, and no candidate OpenAPI path resolved. The design.md/review.md skills are customer-authored context for LightSprint's own agents, not agent-oriented documentation of the product, so they don't count here.
